Android Debug Bridge version 1.0.31

 -a                           listen on all network interfaces
 -d                           use USB device
 -e                           use TCP/IP device
 -s <specific device>         use device with given serial

general commands:
  adb devices [-l]            list connected devices
  adb help                    show this help message
  adb version                 show version num
  adb connect <host>[:<port>] connect to a device via TCP/IP
  adb disconnect [<host>[:<port>]]
  adb forward --list          list all forward socket connections
  adb push <local> <remote>   copy file/dir to device
  adb pull <remote> [<local>] copy file/dir from device
  adb install [-lrtsdg] <file>
  adb install-multiple [-lrtsdpg] <file...>
  adb install-multi-package [-lrtsdpg] <file...>
  adb shell [-e escape] [-n] [-Tt] [-x] [command]
  adb reboot [bootloader|recovery]
  adb sideload <file>

malformed lines:
  adb
  adb --not-a-command
  adb invalid.command ARG
